mapper.select: SELECT C.STUDY_TITLE, A.MEM_ID, CASE A.STUDY_ROLL WHEN 'M' THEN '팀원' WHEN 'L' THEN '팀장' ELSE '알수없음' END AS STUDY_ROLL, B.MEM_NICK, B.MEM_EMAIL, A.STUDY_JOINEDDATE FROM STUDYMEMBER A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) INNER JOIN STUDY C ON (A.STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID) WHERE A.STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND A.STUDY_OUTDATE IS NULL
SELECT A.STUDY_ROLL FROM STUDYMEMBER A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) WHERE A.STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND B.MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId}
SELECT s.MEM_ID, s.STUDY_ID, s.STUDY_ROLL, m.MEM_NICK AS memNick FROM STUDYMEMBER s INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON s.MEM_ID = m.MEM_ID WHERE s.STUDY_ROLL = 'L'

SELECT C.MEM_NICK, CASE WHEN B.STUDY_ROLL = 'L' THEN '팀장' END AS STUDY_ROLL, A.STUDY_TITLE, A.STUDY_CATEGORY, A.STUDY_INTRO, A.STUDY_INTROCONTENT, TO_CHAR(A.STUDY_CREATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS studyCreateDate, A.STUDY_LIKE FROM STUDY A INNER JOIN STUDYMEMBER B ON (A.STUDY_ID = B.STUDY_ID) INNER JOIN MEMBER C ON(B.MEM_ID = C.MEM_ID) WHERE B.STUDY_ROLL = 'L' AND A.STUDY_ID = #{studyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STUDYMEMBER ( MEM_ID, STUDY_ID, STUDY_ROLL, STUDY_JOINEDDATE ) VALUES ( (SELECT MEM_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId}), #{studyId}, 'M', SYSDATE )
